text_block_list.text:
There's a fan meet-and-greet event
today with
Кинг Хало and other students
in her year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Good luck in your next race, King!
text_block_list.name: Girl

text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I plan to win, so make sure to
watch.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Just look how those cute little eyes
sparkle.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Best not to let them down, right?

text_block_list.text:
But of course. How could a first-rate
such as
myself go around crushing
children's dreams?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: King, it's almost time.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Are you ready to rumble?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Our fans came all the way here to see us,
so let's
show them our gratitude.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
What's all this about rumbling and
gratitude?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Did you forget about the mini-concert
after the
meet and greet?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Huh?! A mini-concert?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Judging by your reaction... Don't tell
me...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
But now that I think about it, you did
miss
practice because something came
up.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Still, you said you'd practice on your
own.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
O-of course not! I just filed it away in my
memory
for later!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
But this isn't good... I haven't practiced
the
dance, much less memorized the
lyrics!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Oh my, this is troubling. What to do,
then?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
And I was just saying I wouldn't crush
anyone's
dreams!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: It is troubling! But no need to worry!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The world's hella strongest, El Condor
Pasa, is
here! I'll never abandon you!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Эль Кондор Паса!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
No hay problema! I'll get you caught up
right now!
With my instruction, our
grand finale is secure!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Right now?! That's far too simple a plan!
Surely it
takes some time to learn
everything.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Let's see what Грасс Вандер thinks.

text_block_list.text: Whaaaat?! You're ignoring me?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Well, if two heads are better than one, I
suppose
three would be all the better.
What do you think
we should do, Grass?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Well, this mall does have a music store...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
What if we change the song to
something the
three of us already know?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Change the song?! That's a beautiful
idea!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Nnngh... That's disappointing, but I
guess it's
better than learnin' from
scratch.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
King! Grass! Let's pick a song we can all
already
sing and dance to!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's! I'll buy the CD once we find
something
suitable!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Grass, Эль Кондор Паса, I'm in your debt!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: A little while later...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: The three of us are here to give an unforgettable performance! Here we go, Umapyoi Legend!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All right, got it! Эль Кондор Паса, if you
please!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Okay! Leave it to me!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Fifteen minutes later...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: And so, today's main event is...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
An Эль Кондор Паса vs. Кинг Хало
exhibition
match!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: U-uh, are we really going to do this?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
If you think about it, there's no way you
can learn
a whole song so quickly!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
So, instead of a mini-concert, it's lucha
libre time!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I know you're new at this, but don't
worry! I'll
keep you safe and the crowd
pumped!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Now, show me what you got!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Okay! I'm not really sure what I've got, though!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Good luck out there, you two!
text_block_list.name: Fans

text_block_list.text:
The planned mini-concert has turned
into a
professional wrestling match.
Surprisingly though,
it's received well by
the fans!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to their quick thinking, King
Halo and the
others have managed to
pick the right song and
please their fans.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
